subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Produzir artigos de opinião, tendo em vista o contexto de produção dado, assumindo posição diante de tema polêmico, argumentando de acordo com a estrutura própria desse tipo de texto e utilizando diferentes tipos de argumentos – de autoridade, comprovação, exemplificação princípio etc.

components.description_pt: Apresentar ponto de vista ou opinião clara sobre tópico ou texto em texto de opinião
components.description_en: State a clear point of view or opinion on a topic or text in an opinion piece
components.cc_component_description: State a clear point of view or opinion on a topic or text in an opinion piece

components.description_pt: Construir argumentos alinhados com convenções estruturais do gênero artigo de opinião
components.description_en: Construct arguments aligned with the structural conventions of the opinion article genre
components.cc_component_description: Create an organizational structure that groups related ideas to support the opinion

components.description_pt: Aplicar estratégias argumentativas como apelos à autoridade, evidência, exemplificação e princípio em editorial
components.description_en: Apply argumentative strategies — such as appeals to authority, evidence, exemplification, and principle — in an op-ed
components.cc_component_description: Construct logical reasoning that connects evidence to a claim in an argumentative text

components.description_pt: Escolher linguagem e estilo apropriados ao público, propósito e contexto da comunicação
components.description_en: Choose language and style appropriate to the audience, purpose, and context of communication
components.cc_component_description: Choose language and style appropriate to the audience, purpose, and context of communication

components.description_pt: Avaliar coerência e efetividade persuasiva de estratégias argumentativas usadas em editorial
components.description_en: Evaluate the coherence and persuasive effectiveness of argumentative strategies used in an op-ed
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the effectiveness of an author's rhetoric in advancing their stated purpose

cc_matches.description: Use knowledge of language and its conventions when writing, speaking, reading, or listening.
Write opinion pieces on topics or texts, supporting a point of view with reasons.
Support claim(s) with logical reasoning and relevant evidence, using accurate, credible sources and demonstrating an understanding of the topic or text.
Introduce a topic or text clearly, state an opinion, and create an organizational structure in which related ideas are grouped to support the writer's purpose.
Determine an author's point of view or purpose in a text and analyze how an author uses rhetoric to advance that point of view or purpose.
